name: bb-plugin-switchboard
description: A compact list of the chats open in your bb panes, with bb's own chat sliding open in place. Made for a small second bb window.

bb.name: Switchboard
bb.description: A page listing the chats open in your split panes, in any bb window, with a state word each (Needs you, Working, Done, Idle). Click a row and bb's chat slides open in place; a New chat button starts one on your project checkout. Sized for a 500px second window (Cmd+Shift+N), and it works in the main window too. Cmd+Shift+S opens it.
